analyst.summary: Meesho runs one of India's largest value-focused e-commerce marketplaces and continues to grow revenue at a healthy pace, particularly outside major metros. The company remains substantially loss-making, however, and the pace of improvement in that loss has been only marginal quarter to quarter, while the stock trades at a premium to book value that already assumes real progress toward profitability. We rate this a Sell until the path to sustainable profit is more clearly demonstrated.
